teams.synopsis: The record doesn't show it, but this is the greatest PFFL season ever by PF/G — top dog whenever healthy.
teams.blurb: The record doesn't show it, but STD is having the greatest PFFL season ever by PF/G. Kraft's season-ending injury is brutal, but Henry's a solid replacement. When healthy, this team's the top dog, and I don't see that changing. Aside from Week 10, the schedule's tough, but they'll finish strong. 2025 PPG rank: 1st (137.3) — not only does this lead the PFFL in 2025, but if the season ended today, this would be the highest PPG mark in the league's 6 years! Current record: 6-3. Projected: 10-4.

teams.synopsis: The sole owner of the league's best record, on pace for one of the great regular seasons in PFFL history.
teams.blurb: The sole owner of the best record in the league, MFGA is on pace to have one of the greatest regular seasons in PFFL history. As seen on the left, the franchise had a rough time in the league's first five years, but this year that's changed. Let's see if they finish strong. 2025 PPG rank: 2nd (120.5). 2020-24 PPG rank: 13th (103.7). Current record: 8-1. Projected: 11-3.

teams.synopsis: Deserves to stay in the top 3 despite the Week 9 loss — stars, depth, and good vibes heading into Week 10.
teams.blurb: Despite the loss in Week 9, I believe A$AP Monke deserves to stay within the top 3. They won't go away anytime soon, as I predict them to finish the season strong, going 3-2 and securing a top seed in the 2025 playoffs. The team has their stars, good depth, and good vibes as we head into Week 10. 2023-24 record rank: 14th (7-21). 2025 record rank: 2nd (7-2). Current record: 7-2. Projected: 10-4.

teams.synopsis: Peaked at 4th this week, riding a scorching 4-1 stretch — could this finally be the year?
teams.blurb: A team that's consistently risen as the season has gone on, reaching its peak ranking this week at 4th. New York has been on fire the past five weeks, going 4-1 over that stretch while averaging the third-most PF/G. I'm interested to see if this could finally be their year. PPG weeks 1-4 (1-3): 106.6 (10th). PPG weeks 5-9 (4-1): 124.5 (3rd). Current record: 5-4. Projected: 8-6.

teams.synopsis: Top 3 in PF/G, but a rough sub-95 Week 10 — the boom weeks are there, and a string of them at the right time is dangerous.
teams.blurb: Top 3 in PF/G, averaging about 119.5 points per contest. LaPorta Potty had a rough Week 10, putting up less than 95 points for the third time this season. I think the boom weeks are there for this team, and if they get a string of them at just the right time, the league is in trouble. Games with less than 95 points rank: tied for 11th (3). Games with more than 135 points rank: 1st (4). Current record: 6-3. Projected: 9-5.

teams.synopsis: A completely different team with a healthy Puka — the RB spot is the last piece needed to return to the top.
teams.blurb: As seen on the left, Station Grits is a different team when Puka is healthy. If they stay healthy for a playoff run, I wouldn't disregard them as a contender. Keep an eye on the RB spot, because if they get a consistent guy, the team could return to the top of the rankings as the season ends. PPG with Puka (6-0): 131 (1st). PPG without Puka (0-3): 84.7 (13th). Current record: 6-3. Projected: 9-5.

teams.synopsis: Started 0-3, has won four of the last six — a true playoff team now, with Week 10 looking like an automatic win.
teams.blurb: After starting 0-3, RWB has won four of their last six and looks like a true playoff team. They'll need to continue this streak of winning games as the regular season comes to an end, but I have faith they'll be able to. Week 10 already looks like an automatic win against a depleted opponent. 2025 luck rating rank: 13th (-6). Only 11% of all other all-time PFFL teams have a luck rating of -6 or worse. Simply put, RWB's '25 season has been an unlucky one. Current record: 4-5. Projected: 8-6.

teams.synopsis: So much faith in this team, maybe more than deserved — predicting a 4-1 close to lock up a second straight playoff berth.
teams.blurb: I have so much faith in this team, maybe more than I should. I predict them to go 4-1 over the final 5 weeks of the season, securing a playoff berth for the 2nd straight season. The loss in Week 9 was unfortunate, but I don't think it was needed to make the push — we shall see, though. All-time win percentage rank: 14th (38%). Currently, this franchise holds the worst all-time win percentage for any PFFL team, but that could change in the final five weeks of the season. Current record: 4-5. Projected: 8-6.

teams.synopsis: Started 1-4, now 3-1 over the last four weeks with a tight scoring band — the consistency alone earns real playoff hope.
teams.blurb: What to do with you, that's the question I've been trying to answer all season. Started the season 1-4, and now in the past 4 weeks the team is 3-1, while scoring between 110 and 130 in every matchup. For the consistency alone, I think this team has a shot to make a playoff push. Tee Higgins PPG before the Flacco trade (1-4): 8.16. Tee Higgins PPG since the Flacco trade (3-1): 19.33. Current record: 4-5. Projected: 6-8.

teams.synopsis: Could this be an overreaction? Maybe, but the wins simply haven't matched the point totals so far.
teams.blurb: Could this be an overreaction? Very easily, but even if I think the team is better than 10th, they're currently 3-6 and really have to win at least 4 games in the final 5 weeks to make the playoffs. The PF/G is there, but the wins aren't, and that might just be the story of the Minutemen's 2025. 2020-24 average luck rating rank: 13th (-4.2). 2025 luck rating rank: 12th (-4). Current record: 3-6. Projected: 6-8.

teams.synopsis: A 5-year all-time playoff streak looks likely to end in 2025 — unless the Swift and Rhamondre injuries linger elsewhere.
teams.blurb: As you can tell by the projected record, I don't have much faith in this team. I'm happy to get the win and avoid punishment, but I don't see a playoff push in 2025, ending the 5-year streak. Still, miracles happen, and if the Swift and Rhamondre injuries linger for the opponents, this team could surprise. All-time playoff appearances rank: tied for 1st (5) — one of only two franchises to make the playoffs every year, so far. Chances don't look good in '25. Current record: 4-5. Projected: 4-10.

teams.synopsis: A 7th loss puts the playoff hopes to bed — the only goal left is avoiding punishment.
teams.blurb: With the 7th loss of the season in Week 9, playoff hopes appear dead. In this league, the 8th seed is usually 7-7, sometimes 6-8 if there aren't enough .500 teams. The PF/G haven't been there, and I don't see that changing enough in the final 5 weeks. All they need to do now is avoid punishment. PPG without Rashee (1-5): 95.9 (14th). PPG with Rashee (1-2): 113.8 (7th). Current record: 2-7. Projected: 4-10.

teams.synopsis: A Week 9 win over the league's last-place team keeps punishment off the table, but the playoffs remain a stretch.
teams.blurb: With a win in Week 9 against the 14th-ranked team, I believe they can rest easy knowing they most likely avoided punishment in 2025. Now, playoffs are a stretch, but they aren't mathematically eliminated yet, so I guess that's something. Still, I wouldn't get your hopes up. 2024 PPG rank: 1st (128.7). 2025 PPG rank: 14th (94). Current record: 3-6. Projected: 3-11.

teams.synopsis: Week 9 may have been the last real shot to climb out of 14th — avoiding punishment now looks like a long shot.
teams.blurb: I fear Week 9 was this team's last chance to climb out of 14th. A loss to (Dan wash)Burn doesn't help TTF's chances of avoiding punishment, but it doesn't bury them either. If by some miracle they scrape a couple wins in their final 5 games, they could avoid Don's, but that's a long shot. If accurate, TTF will tie Gegwich's 2023 team for the worst win percentage in PFFL history (14%). Current record: 1-8. Projected: 2-12.
